data.name: Jannu
data.gender_notes: Jannu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jannu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jani', meaning 'born'. The name Jannu signifies 'God's Grace' or 'Born of God'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings and prosperity to the one who bears it. The name Jannu carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jannu usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jannu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannu total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
